sentences.en: Algeria and Morocco are geographically and culturally like fraternal twins.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥在地理位置和文化上就像亲兄弟一样。

sentences.en: Culturally, there is much common ground between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 从文化角度来看，这两个国家有很多共同点。

sentences.en: There is much in common between the two countries culturally.
sentences.zh: 这两个国家在文化上有许多共通之处。

senses.zh: 从文化角度,文化意义上,从人文学角度,人文学方面
